Three-Circle.why: Makes ceramic ferrules and sleeves for optical connectors and devices (sales up on data-center construction) and MLCCs (volume, revenue and prices recovering)
Three-Circle.evidence: 2026 half-year report (08-28-2026): as global data-center construction accelerates and optical-device demand rises, sales of ferrules, sleeves and related optical-communication products grew; MLCC sales volume and revenue grew substantially

players.product: ceramic ferrules and sleeves for optical connectors and devices

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 6,423.33 million, up 54.82% YoY; operating profit RMB 2,226.77 million, up 56.05%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,932.12 million, up 56.18%. Electronic and communication components and materials revenue RMB 6,080.74 million at a 44.23% gross margin (up 2.52 points). The company attributes growth to rising customer recognition of its MLCCs and demand growth in optical communications and other industries.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 6,423.33 million (+54.82%); net profit RMB 1,932.12 million (+56.18%); gross margin 44.23%

quarterly_data.signal: Optical: as global data-center construction accelerates and optical-device demand keeps rising, sales of the company's ferrules, sleeves and related optical-communication products grew year on year in H1 2026.

players.product: multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), including high-capacity series

quarterly_data.signal: MLCC: benefiting from rising customer recognition and the industry upturn, prices of some MLCC specifications recovered to their original reasonable level, and MLCC sales volume and revenue grew substantially year on year in H1 2026.
Capacity: the ready-for-use date of the high-capacity MLCC expansion project was postponed from May 10, 2025 to May 31, 2027 to adapt to the external environment.
